long_biography.plain_text:
Marine conservation became Prince Khaled bin Sultan's defining institution outside government service. After seeing the decline of coral reefs while diving, he established the Living Oceans Foundation to combine scientific research, education and public outreach. He continues to oversee the organisation as chairman, while its operating leadership increasingly rests with his daughter, Princess Hala.

The foundation's Global Reef Expedition conducted large-scale coral surveys and habitat mapping across tropical seas. Its findings have informed marine protected areas and spatial planning, while its educational programmes train students, teachers and coastal communities. This science-led model turned his personal concern for reefs into a sustained international conservation programme.
